== Published English Original Virtual Set 5 wording ==
The original title omits the apostrophe. The later slip adds a vehicle slot and fixes Bossk’s attrition immunity at less than 4. It drops the Bossk power bonus and the ship-docking clause. Both keep the original subtype, matching Bossk battle destiny, and starfighter movement.
